description.value: Original Hot Yoga Abbotsford is the Fraser Valley's first hot yoga studio, open since 2007 in Abbotsford's downtown core. It offers a range of heated yoga formats including the classic 26-posture Bikram sequence, Yin Yoga, Hot Core Fusion, and Kundalini Yoga and Meditation. Touring cyclists seeking muscle recovery and flexibility work between riding days may find a drop-in class appealing.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 41m; rack (3 spaces) at 54m; rack (4 spaces) at 72m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and confirms Original Hot Yoga Abbotsford as a functioning yoga studio established in 2007, offering Bikram, Yin, Hot Core Fusion, and Kundalini classes; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, showers, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. The OSM tag internet_access=wlan is not corroborated by the website so it is left null per instructions. OSM lists the community as 'Chilliwack' but the postal code V2S 5M4 and Essendene Avenue address place the studio firmly in Abbotsford, not Chilliwack.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the address (33772 Essendene Avenue, V2S 5M4) is in Abbotsford — incorrect community attribution in OSM.
Multiple service subpages contain Lorem Ipsum placeholder text, indicating the website was never fully built out beyond the front page.
No phone number present in OSM tags or on the website.
OSM internet_access=wlan tag could not be corroborated by website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The studio is a legitimate active business that could appeal to touring cyclists for recovery yoga, but none of the required cycling-friendly amenities are confirmed, making it impossible to assess WWC fit without on-site verification.

wow_evidence: Hot yoga studio with explicit drop-in classes — drop-in access distinguishes it from booking-only studios (Abby Yoga excluded).
blurb: Hot yoga studio downtown; drop-in classes for recovery days.
